# Assets · Icons

20 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

These are the glyphs `PhantomPortals.Icon` and every `icon=` prop render — mount the component wherever the bundle runs; the files are for surfaces without it (a deck).

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for ai-core.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Icons

20 original icons on a 24px grid: 1.75px square-capped `#151519` (ink-primary) strokes plus exactly one `#A0112B` (accent-crimson) accent each — the accent marks what the icon *does* (the lens handle, the cursor, the active node).

- Two-tone files are for documentation, menus and tiles on light surfaces.
- In UI, use them as masks so they take `currentColor` (one ink): `<span class="pp-icon" style="--icon:url(…)"></span>` from bundle.css. On `surface-inverse` they render `ink-on-inverse-secondary`, active ones white or `accent-crimson-on-inverse`.
- Sizes: 16, 20 (default), 24. Below 16px use a text label instead.
- Every icon-only control needs an accessible name and a tooltip.

Set: search, home-portal, back, forward, reload, bookmark, terminal, diagnostics, ai-core, tools, folder, network, shield, cpu, cloud, settings, power, alert, check, close.
